scope:
Real Geant4 option4 electromagnetic receiver transport, native energy scorers.

No photonuclear physics. Closed cavity returns are tracked by native geometry.
Escaped calorimetric energy is K for e- and K+2mec2 for e+, preserving positron
annihilation potential. Single-purpose process exits after validation/persistence,
avoiding the observed Python/Geant4 destruction-order crash after completed runs.
Default disables the defective Geant4 11.4.1 in-flight3gamma branch, retaining
standard2gamma annihilation. This approximation and its sensitivity are explicit.
Cuts are applied through Geant4 UI because inherited Python physics-list methods
misaddress the base object in this wheel; actual material-couple tables are logged.
cut_configuration: Geant4 UI /run/setCut after Initialize; actual built material-couple table printed by /run/dumpCouples and verified by campaign script
energy_closure_policy: max event residual<1e-4 and mean absolute residual<1e-7 of calorimetric input; no event renormalization. A documented S250 pair-recoil boundary step contributes217eV excess to one of20000 5.657MeV events, ensemble relative1.92e-9.
physics: G4EmStandardPhysics_option4 with explicit /process/em/3GammaAnnihilationOnFly setting;default false uses standard two-gamma in-flight model;at-rest Allison model unchanged; fluorescence+Auger+deexcitationIgnoreCut;100eV lowest electron; no photonuclear/hadronic processes
scoring: Native G4PSEnergyDeposit for hot graphite and vacuum; Python tracking callbacks only tally final outer escapes and residuals. World boundary10m outside receiver.
process_exit: All requested histories, energy checks and output persistence completed before os._exit to avoid observed binding destruction-order fault. No physics steps or remaining tracks truncated.
archive_note: Per-event tallies are preserved losslessly in ../events/S350-broad.json.gz; original raw file hash is in run-provenance.json.
